blocks.text: Any street, alley or easement may be vacated without further proceedings upon the filing with the Register of Deeds of any plat or replat which has been approved in the manner prescribed by TMC Title 18 , Division 3 , on subdivision regulations. (Code 1981 § 40-225. Code 1995 § 130-478.)
